## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

### What is Constella?

**Constella** is an **Enterprise AI Operating Platform** — a self-hosted, multi-agent ecosystem that functions as an AI engineering organization for software development lifecycle management. Unlike traditional AI coding assistants that treat development as isolated tasks, Constella creates an **AI engineering team** that works within your infrastructure, follows your rules, and delivers enterprise-grade results.

### Key Differentiators

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Chief Architect Agent** | Central orchestrator using LangGraph for intelligent task decomposition |
| **Specialized Gold Standard Agents** | 9+ expert agents (CodeCraft, SecuriShield, DesignForge, etc.) |
| **Hybrid Knowledge System** | Neo4j (graph) + Qdrant (vectors) + Redis (cache) |
| **Multi-Provider LLM** | Claude Sonnet 4, GPT-4o, Claude Haiku with intelligent routing |
| **SOC-2 Compliance** | Built-in governance, audit trails, and policy enforcement |
| **Self-Hosted** | Complete data sovereignty and enterprise control |

### Orchestrator Service (Core)

**Technology:** FastAPI (Python 3.11) + Uvicorn

**Key Endpoints:**
- `GET /health` - Service health check
- `GET /agents` - List available agents (JWT required)
- `POST /analyze` - Execute analysis workflow (JWT required)
- `POST /agents/{name}/execute` - Direct agent execution
- `WebSocket /ws` - Real-time progress updates

**Advanced Features (chief_architect.py):**
- Task decomposition with DAG creation
- Topological sorting for dependencies
- Knowledge graph integration (Neo4j)
- Vector embeddings (Qdrant)
- Project context persistence
- 8 task types supported

### Agent API Contract (ADR-012)

All agents implement a standardized REST API:

```typescript
// Required Endpoints
GET  /health       → { status, details, llm_configured?, llm_cost_usd? }
GET  /capabilities → { agent_id, agent_type, task_type, capabilities[] }
POST /execute_task → { task_id, status, result, metrics }

// Authentication
Authorization: Bearer <JWT from ChiefArchitect>
```

### Agent Capabilities Matrix

| Agent | Primary Capabilities | LLM Model |
|-------|---------------------|-----------|
| **CodeCraft** | Code generation, refactoring, implementation | GPT-4o |
| **SecuriShield** | OWASP scanning, CVE detection, threat modeling | Claude Sonnet |
| **DesignForge** | C4 diagrams, architecture patterns, ADR generation | GPT-4o |
| **PerfPulse** | Bottleneck analysis, optimization suggestions | GPT-4o-mini |
| **Evaluator** | Code quality, technical debt, test coverage | GPT-4o-mini |
| **SOC2-Compliance** | Policy validation, evidence collection | Claude Sonnet |

## 5. KNOWLEDGE & MEMORY SYSTEMS

### Three-Database Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    KNOWLEDGE LAYER                          │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                             │
│  ┌─────────────┐   ┌─────────────┐   ┌─────────────┐       │
│  │   Neo4j     │   │   Qdrant    │   │   Redis     │       │
│  │             │   │             │   │             │       │
│  │ • Entities  │   │ • Embeddings│   │ • Sessions  │       │
│  │ • Relations │   │ • Semantic  │   │ • Cache     │       │
│  │ • Workflows │   │   Search    │   │ • Pub/Sub   │       │
│  │ • Decisions │   │ • RAG       │   │ • State     │       │
│  │             │   │             │   │             │       │
│  │ Port: 7474  │   │ Port: 6333  │   │ Port: 6379  │       │
│  └─────────────┘   └─────────────┘   └─────────────┘       │
│                                                             │
│  Data Flow: Actions → Redis Queue → ETL → Qdrant + Neo4j   │
│                                                             │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Memory Collections

| Collection | Store | Purpose |
|------------|-------|---------|
| `project_knowledge` | Qdrant | Project-specific embeddings |
| `architectural_patterns` | Qdrant | Design pattern library |
| `inter_agent_context` | Qdrant | Cross-agent communication |
| `workflow_nodes` | Neo4j | Task execution graphs |
| `agent_sessions` | Redis | Active session state |

## 6. LLM PROVIDER INTEGRATION

### Multi-Provider Strategy

**Three-Tier Model Selection:**

| Tier | Model | Use Cases | Cost |
|------|-------|-----------|------|
| **Senior** | Claude Sonnet 4 | Architecture, strategy, security | High |
| **Complex** | GPT-4o | Code generation, refactoring | Medium |
| **Routine** | Claude Haiku / GPT-3.5 | Formatting, simple fixes | Low |

### LLM Provider Package Features

```python
# Unified Request/Response
LLMRequest(
    agent_id: str,
    task_type: str,
    system_prompt: str,
    user_prompt: str,
    temperature: float = 0.2,
    max_tokens: int = 4096,
    json_mode: bool = False,
    preferred_provider: Optional[ProviderName] = None
)

# Features
✅ Circuit Breaker (3 failures → 60s recovery)
✅ Rate Limiting (60 RPM, 100K TPM)
✅ Cost Tracking ($10/day budget alerts)
✅ Redis Response Cache (256 entries, 1hr TTL)
✅ Automatic Failover between providers
✅ Task-based model routing
```

### Supported Providers

| Provider | Models | Package |
|----------|--------|---------|
| **OpenAI** | gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4-turbo | Python + TypeScript |
| **Anthropic** | claude-3-5-sonnet, claude-3-haiku | Python + TypeScript |
| **Google Gemini** | gemini-pro, gemini-1.5-pro | TypeScript only |
| **OpenRouter** | 100+ models | TypeScript only |
| **Ollama** | Local models | Python only |

## 7. SECURITY POSTURE

### Current Security Score: 2/5 ⚠️

### Critical Findings

| ID | Finding | Severity | Status |
|----|---------|----------|--------|
| SEC-001 | Hardcoded secrets (NEO4J_AUTH=none) | 🔴 CRITICAL | Open |
| SEC-002 | Grafana default credentials (admin/admin) | 🔴 CRITICAL | Open |
| SEC-003 | No service-to-service mTLS | 🔴 CRITICAL | Open |
| SEC-004 | Orchestrator CORS allow-* | 🟠 HIGH | Open |
| SEC-005 | Unauthenticated /metrics endpoints | 🟠 HIGH | Open |
| SEC-006 | No input validation framework | 🟠 HIGH | Open |
| SEC-007 | Missing rate limiting on agents | 🟡 MEDIUM | Open |

### Security Architecture Needed

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    ZERO TRUST SECURITY                      │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                             │

│       │                                                     │
│       ▼                                                     │
│  ┌─────────┐    ┌─────────┐    ┌─────────┐                 │
│  │   WAF   │───▶│   TLS   │───▶│  Auth   │                 │
│  │         │    │ Termin. │    │ Gateway │                 │
```
